title: SPEC: a dedicated ~32GB mini that ticks ALL DAY on ecosystem decisions (Brian, 2026-10-23 — mused as a need, NOT an approved purchase). Duties: (1) curate the 120 best ruling candidates from the daily inflow (the prioritizer for the 200+/day problem); (2) frame each as a decision-ready item — summary written (entry fee enforced), stakes, and THE CONTROVERSY pulled in (evidence both ways, prior rulings, open disagreements); (3) assign the FOUR CHAIRS per item by seat record + domain fit (replaces keyword routing, whose beta failures: zilara gate -> fallback seat, delivery-channel -> Trading Desk); (4) post-session, crunch results — learning-ledger import, open-loop chasing; (5) send its thoughts UP to Altair (operations) and Meghan (executive) for THEIR decisions (R35). Absorbs: queue_watch strata, learning brief, brief-building, chair assignment. Sizing: 32GB / 780M class — persistence over speed.
call: APPROVE the SPEC for the dedicated mini to handle ecosystem decisions
rationale: It addresses the critical need for efficient decision-making and streamlines the process across multiple domains.

title: FOLLOW-UP from the 2026-10-23 morning-one board fixes: the wave-2 CLOSER (run_seat) still runs with NO item budget — the agenda deadline only gates its start, so a closer stall is the same infinite-retry class the 3x rule fixed for agenda items. Give the closer its own budget (sized for a consolidation call, e.g. 3x the loop median item time x items consolidated, or a flat config value) + park-and-carry semantics: if the closer times out, the loop rulings are already persisted per-decision, so the session must still record/verify/minutes and carry consolidation to next session.
call: Approve the item with the condition that the closer's budget be set to a flat config value of 15 minutes
rationale: This ensures the closer has sufficient time without overcomplicating the system with dynamic budget calculations.

title: DECIDER QUEUE (Brian 2026-10-23 09:11, R37 amendment): build the Meghan/Altair side of the confidence triage once the x4 panel exists (task:board-morpheus-x4). Inputs per item: 4 draws (direction each), avg confidence, agreement. Tier A: 4/4 same direction AND avg >= 0.98 -> decider debate queue FIRST (fast debate; unanimous 14Bs can still share a blind spot, so debate is the check, not a rubber stamp). Tier B: rest, ordered by avg confidence DESC with an age/starvation guard so the tail cannot rot; each Tier B item must carry a WHY-NOT-98 analysis before debate — classify the doubt: (a) missing information -> research order, (b) genuine controversy -> clerk pulls evidence both ways, (c) thin framing -> back to enrichment. The why-analysis is prepared in the crunch shift (Bravo/Altair), not burned in live decider time. Calibration duty: log panel agreement + stated confidence vs DECIDER outcomes in atlas.board_suggestions so the 0.98 line itself gets tuned by evidence over time (a line nothing reaches, or everything reaches, is a broken line).
call: Approve the DECIDER QUEUE amendment as proposed
rationale: The amendment introduces a structured and calibrated decision-making process that ensures thorough analysis and debate, improving the reliability of outcomes.
